summary: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited condensed financial statements and MD&A for Q2 2026, along with a press release reporting results. The filing covers revenues of $318.9M (Q2 2026), EPS of $5.90, and a declared dividend of $5.25 per share payable August 21, 2026. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other strategic event is described. The dividend is ordinary course. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report, so no special-situation category applies.
